title: HRTF Upsampling and Personalization via Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.20400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Head-related transfer function (HRTF) spatial upsampling from sparse measurements is a fundamental challenge in personalized binaural audio. We formulate HRTF upsampling as an operator learning problem and introduce SPARO, a neural operator that maps sparse measurements at a set of spatial directions to the HRTF field, a continuous representation that can be queried at arbitrary positions. SPARO projects the measurements onto a learned set of spherical latent modes, processes the latent modes with Transformer blocks, and decodes the resulting representations at query directions. On SONICOM, using the LAP24 measurement configuration, SPARO attains the best log-spectral distortion (LSD) and interaural level difference (ILD) error at every sparsity level from 3 to 100 measurements (18% lower LSD and 43% lower ILD error than the strongest baseline at 100 measurements) while remaining competitive in interaural time difference (ITD) error. I

translated_title: 基于神经算子的HRTF上采样与个性化
translated_abstract: 从头相关传输函数（HRTF）的稀疏测量进行空间上采样是个性化双耳音频中的一项根本性挑战。我们将HRTF上采样表述为一个算子学习问题，并提出了SPARO——一种神经算子，它将一组空间方向上的稀疏测量映射到HRTF场，这是一种可以在任意位置查询的连续表示。SPARO将测量投影到学习得到的球面潜在模式集合上，使用Transformer块处理这些潜在模式，并在查询方向上解码所得的表示。在SONICOM数据集上，使用LAP24测量配置，SPARO在从3到100个测量的每个稀疏度水平上都取得了最佳的对数谱失真（LSD）和耳间电平差（ILD）误差（在100个测量时，LSD比最强基线低18%，ILD误差低43%），同时在耳间时间差（ITD）误差方面保持竞争力。
tldr: SPARO是一种将稀疏空间测量映射为连续HRTF场的神经算子，在SONICOM数据集的所有稀疏度水平上均实现了最优的LSD和ILD误差，显著优于现有最强基线。
